# pltr admin

Admin operations for user, group, and organization management

25 commands. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

## pltr admin group

Manage groups (by group ID, a UUID).

### pltr admin group batch-get

Get several groups in one request.

`pltr admin group batch-get GROUP_IDS... [OPTIONS]`

- `GROUP_IDS...`: Group IDs (UUIDs), separated by spaces (at most 500).
- SDK: `admin.Group.get_batch`

### pltr admin group create

Create a group.

`pltr admin group create NAME [OPTIONS]`

- `NAME`: Name of the new group.
- `--organization` TEXT (repeatable): RID of an organization whose members can see the group (required; repeat for several).
- `--attribute` TEXT (repeatable): Group attribute (repeat for several attributes, or for several values of one).
- `--description` TEXT: Description.
- SDK: `admin.Group.create`

### pltr admin group delete

Delete a group.

`pltr admin group delete GROUP_ID [OPTIONS]`

- `GROUP_ID`: Group ID (a UUID; find one with 'pltr admin group search <name>').
- **destructive** (asks first; `--yes` skips) · SDK: `admin.Group.delete`

### pltr admin group get

Get a group.

`pltr admin group get GROUP_ID [OPTIONS]`

- `GROUP_ID`: Group ID (a UUID; find one with 'pltr admin group search <name>').
- SDK: `admin.Group.get`

### pltr admin group list

List groups.

`pltr admin group list [OPTIONS]`

- paged · SDK: `admin.Group.list`

### pltr admin group search

Search groups by name.

`pltr admin group search QUERY [OPTIONS]`

- `QUERY`: Start of a group name (any case).
- paged · SDK: `admin.Group.search`

## pltr admin marking

Manage markings (by marking ID).

### pltr admin marking batch-get

Get several markings in one request.

`pltr admin marking batch-get MARKING_IDS... [OPTIONS]`

- `MARKING_IDS...`: Marking IDs, separated by spaces (at most 500).
- SDK: `admin.Marking.get_batch`

### pltr admin marking create

Create a marking.

`pltr admin marking create NAME --category-id TEXT --role TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `NAME`: Name of the new marking (unique within its category).
- `--category-id` TEXT (required): ID of the marking category to create the marking in.
- `--role` TEXT (required; repeatable): Give a user or group (by ID, a UUID) a role on the marking: ADMINISTER, DECLASSIFY or USE.
- `--member` TEXT (repeatable): ID (a UUID) of a user or group that can view resources protected by the marking (repeat for several).
- `--description` TEXT: Description.
- SDK: `admin.Marking.create`

### pltr admin marking get

Get a marking.

`pltr admin marking get MARKING_ID [OPTIONS]`

- `MARKING_ID`: Marking ID (find it with 'pltr admin marking list').
- SDK: `admin.Marking.get`

### pltr admin marking list

List markings.

`pltr admin marking list [OPTIONS]`

- `--include-deleted`, `--exclude-deleted`: Include or leave out deleted markings (default: the API includes them).
- `--marking-type` MANDATORY|CBAC: Only list markings of this type (default: every type).
- paged · SDK: `admin.Marking.list`

### pltr admin marking replace

Rename a marking, and change its description.

`pltr admin marking replace MARKING_ID NAME [OPTIONS]`

- `MARKING_ID`: Marking ID (find it with 'pltr admin marking list').
- `NAME`: New name of the marking.
- `--description` TEXT: New description (default: keep the current one).
- **destructive** (asks first; `--yes` skips) · SDK: `admin.Marking.get`, `admin.Marking.replace`

## pltr admin org

Manage organizations (by organization RID).

### pltr admin org available-roles

List the roles that can be assigned in an organization.

`pltr admin org available-roles ORGANIZATION_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `ORGANIZATION_RID`: Organization RID (ri.multipass..organization.<id>); 'pltr admin user get <user ID>' shows a user's organization.
- SDK: `admin.Organization.list_available_roles`

### pltr admin org create

[beta] Create an organization.

`pltr admin org create NAME --enrollment-rid TEXT --admin-id TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `NAME`: Name of the new organization.
- `--enrollment-rid` TEXT (required): RID of the enrollment the organization belongs to.
- `--admin-id` TEXT (required; repeatable): ID (a UUID) of a user or group that administers the organization (required; repeat for several).
- `--description` TEXT: Description.
- `--host` TEXT: Primary host name of the organization, used in its users' URLs.
- beta · SDK: `admin.Organization.create`

### pltr admin org get

Get an organization.

`pltr admin org get ORGANIZATION_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `ORGANIZATION_RID`: Organization RID (ri.multipass..organization.<id>); 'pltr admin user get <user ID>' shows a user's organization.
- SDK: `admin.Organization.get`

### pltr admin org replace

Rename an organization, and change its description or host.

`pltr admin org replace ORGANIZATION_RID NAME [OPTIONS]`

- `ORGANIZATION_RID`: Organization RID (ri.multipass..organization.<id>); 'pltr admin user get <user ID>' shows a user's organization.
- `NAME`: New name of the organization.
- `--description` TEXT: New description (default: keep the current one).
- `--host` TEXT: New primary host name (default: keep the current one).
- **destructive** (asks first; `--yes` skips) · SDK: `admin.Organization.get`, `admin.Organization.replace`
